## About Me

I am a Phd candidate in the [**Department of Economics**](https://econ.unm.edu/) at [**The University of New Mexico**](https://www.unm.edu/).

Before joining UNM, I worked on several applied research projects in Nepal, including studies with the National Planning Commission, tobacco harm reduction, COVID-19-affected MSMEs, and household surveys conducted through ADB and Tribhuvan University. I also taught economics at the undergraduate level. These experiences shaped my interest in behavioral, experimental, and public economics, which I hope to explore further through my research at UNM.

Beyond academia, I enjoy spending time on sports, music, and content creation. I play and explore music, follow sports, and create videos for my social media platforms and YouTube channel.
